summary: Backend 15/18 passed (83%). All 3 failures share ONE critical root cause: FastAPI route-ordering conflict — the generic '/admin/{kind}/{uid}/toggle' route (line 1395) is registered BEFORE the specific '/admin/rcg-users/{uid}/toggle' route (line 1498), so every POST to /admin/rcg-users/{uid}/toggle is captured by toggle_user() (which allows any RCG role and looks up master_acrm/master_marketing_asset collections) and returns 404 instead of hitting the controller-only handler that would return 200/403. This bypasses the RCG_CONTROLLER guard for the toggle endpoint. All frontend checks passed on mobile viewport (390x844): gradient teal + gold Pacifico tagline 'Menghubungkan Investor dengan Asset BSI' visible; 'Terdekat' and 'Pilih Titik' chips visible; 'Pilih Titik' opens map picker modal with 'Cari Aset Terdekat dari Titik Ini' CTA; controller (2183008345) sees RCG tab in Kelola with 'Ubah Data Diri Saya' + 'Tambah RCG Admin' sections; rcg_admin (2186005002) does NOT see RCG tab (only User/Kategori/Audit/Laporan). Legacy admin/admin2 login correctly returns 401. MA Manado (tad2310129981) and MA Jakarta Thamrin (tad24040100322) log in successfully. Nearest catalog search returns items sorted ascending by distance_km. Also noted a secondary risk: users.username has a unique MongoDB index but rcg-user delete is soft (sets deleted_at) without renaming username — recreating a rcg_admin with the same NIP later hits E11000 DuplicateKeyError → 500.

critical.issue: Route-ordering bug: shadowed by generic '/admin/{kind}/{uid}/toggle' at server.py:1395 (registered earlier). Requests never reach toggle_rcg_admin() at server.py:1498. Effect: (1) rcg_admin can call it and receive 404 instead of 403 (RBAC guard bypassed — the generic handler uses require(*RCG_ROLES) which admits rcg_admin), (2) controller gets 404 on toggling a real rcg-user because generic handler queries the wrong collection (master_acrm/master_marketing_asset), (3) controller-only protection of the RCG_CONTROLLER row (403) never fires. Fix: move the two specific POST/DELETE rcg-users routes ABOVE '/admin/{kind}/{uid}/toggle' (i.e. before line 1395), or make the generic handler reject kind='rcg-users' and require an explicit whitelist.

Soft-delete + unique index conflict. users collection has a unique index on 'username'; delete_rcg_admin() at server.py:1517 only sets deleted_at without renaming username. Creating a new rcg_admin with the same NIP later fails with pymongo E11000 DuplicateKeyError → 500 (the 409 pre-check at 1488 filters by deleted_at:None and returns nothing, so the insert proceeds). Fix: on delete, rename username to a tombstone (e.g. '{username}__deleted_{ts}') or drop/change the unique index to be partial on deleted_at:None.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on Expo web; ignore unless behavior degrades on device.

Deprecation warnings on web preview: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Consider migrating shadow* → boxShadow and moving pointerEvents into style for RN 0.75+/react-native-web compat.

action_items: FIX ROUTE ORDER (CRITICAL): In /app/backend/server.py move the block '@api.post("/admin/rcg-users")' + '@api.post("/admin/rcg-users/{uid}/toggle")' + '@api.delete("/admin/rcg-users/{uid}")' + '@api.put("/admin/rcg/self")' + '@api.get("/admin/rcg-users")' (lines 1470-1543) to be defined BEFORE '@api.post("/admin/{kind}/{uid}/toggle")' at line 1395. Alternative: change the generic route to '@api.post("/admin/{kind:regex(marketing-asset|acrm)}/{uid}/toggle")' or add an explicit 404 for kind == 'rcg-users' inside toggle_user().

FIX SOFT-DELETE COLLISION (HIGH): In delete_rcg_admin (server.py:1511) and/or in create_rcg_admin (server.py:1483), either (a) rename username to a tombstone on delete: `"username": f"{username}__del_{now_iso()}"`, or (b) migrate the users.username unique index to a partial index `{ partialFilterExpression: { deleted_at: null } }`.
OPTIONAL CLEANUP: Migrate '"shadow*"' style props to 'boxShadow' and move 'pointerEvents' prop into style to silence deprecation warnings on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1395 vs 1498: FastAPI matches routes in registration order — the two overlapping toggle routes MUST be reordered or the generic one must exclude 'rcg-users'.

server.py:1483-1519: soft-delete design conflicts with the unique index on users.username; either use tombstone renames or a partial unique index. This will manifest as intermittent 500s in production the moment a controller deletes and re-adds an RCG admin with the same NIP.

server.py:1471: GET /admin/rcg-users is guarded by require(*RCG_ROLES) — so rcg_admin can list controllers/admins (their IDs are exposed). This is functionally OK per spec (rcg_admin retains read-only visibility) but confirm PII exposure is intentional; frontend does hide toggle/delete buttons for rcg_admin by not rendering the tab.

rca_of_issue: PRIMARY BUG (3 failing backend tests): FastAPI evaluates routes in registration order. `@api.post('/admin/{kind}/{uid}/toggle')` at server.py:1395 is defined BEFORE `@api.post('/admin/rcg-users/{uid}/toggle')` at server.py:1498. The path 'rcg-users' matches the {kind} placeholder, so every POST to /admin/rcg-users/{uid}/toggle is dispatched to toggle_user(kind='rcg-users', uid=...) which: (a) uses require(*RCG_ROLES) — admitting rcg_admin, bypassing the intended RCG_CONTROLLER guard, (b) queries db.master_acrm.find_one({...}) which never matches an rcg user id → HTTPException(404). Repro: `curl -X POST $URL/api/admin/rcg-users/<any-id>/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer <rcg_admin_token>'` → 404. Expected: 403. SECONDARY BUG (500 on re-create): users.username unique index + soft-delete pattern collide; observable when a controller deletes and re-adds an rcg_admin with the same NIP within the same DB instance. Mitigation for both listed in action_items.
